title: Hruday statement on state identification: what the closeness lemma does and does not establish
accepted: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (model AQ_patterned_zero_selected: SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0) with Haar product reference P_R, 21 omitted faces per anchor entering as -(tau/3)W_f in normalized units delta=alpha/8; both signs |tau|<=10^-8; cover R={0,e_z} of the original xz Wilson loop, 48 links, 36 endpoints, 7 incident anchors; observable class B(H_R); common clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar), with the two named construction families F1 = centered whole-star boxes Lambda_N (AQ1) and F2 = all-contained-face boxes with padding (I1 section 6) on the same Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N>=2, and with every constant read as an exact rational from the AY1 gate: (1) For every pair of subsequential limits of the named construction families F1 and F2 at the same coupling, on the fixed cover R and for the frozen observable class, the reduced densities satisfy ||rho_R - rho'_R||_1 <= 2D and agree to first order in tau; this does not assert equality of the states, whole-sequence convergence, translation invariance, boundary independence of the dynamics, or a rate in N. (tau included in rho^(1)_R; each face term is rank two with eigenvalues +-|tau|/144, the sum is rank two with eigenvalues +-sqrt(10)tau/144) has trace norm sqrt(10)|tau|/72 and Tr(rho^(1)_R W)=+tau/144; for a chosen subsequential limit of either family, every one separately, ||rho_R-P_R-rho^(1)_R||_1<=K_2' tau^2 (AY1 gate accepted items (2)-(3)) with K_2'=966771578474926086618624139557778885954947547760216752246561/72052885697817210754545804931891200000000000000000000000 (~13417.5275440), so any two such limits at the same tau satisfy ||rho_R-rho'_R||_1<=2K_2' tau^2=966771578474926086618624139557778885954947547760216752246561/360264428489086053772729024659456000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (~2.68350550879e-12). Equivalently, for every A in B(H_R) with ||A||<=1, |omega'(A)-omega''(A)|<=2D (order tau) and <=2K_2' tau^2 (order tau^2 after the common first-order density cancels); two limits satisfying this may differ by the stated order on R and without bound elsewhere. (2) Two-sided tier first_order_distance_from_product, a static property of the state on R: for every subsequential limit of either family, at either sign and every |tau|<=10^-8 (K_2'(|tau|) is nondecreasing, so the cap value bounds every smaller |tau|), sqrt(10)|tau|/72 - K_2' tau^2 <= ||rho_R-P_R||_1 <= sqrt(10)|tau|/72 + K_2' tau^2; certified at |tau|=10^-8 with the directed bracket sqrt(10) in [197642353760523708249930846527/62500000000000000000000000000, 3162277660168379331998893544433/1000000000000000000000000000000] as 315493271189404369878663368737136921794795815043212654249128159/720528856978172107545458049318912000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (~4.37863477824e-10) <= ||rho_R-P_R||_1 <= 317426814346354222051900617016352553019063789598114401371582241/720528856978172107545458049318912000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (~4.40546983333e-10); relative width (upper-lower)/(sqrt10_lower |tau|/72) <= 966771578474926086618624139607815612133987277450873561227041/158230021383939647982640996438347350340375381295486435500687360 (~6.10991245541e-3) <= 1/100 (preregistered target, margin ~1.6367); the skeptic's independent enclosure with a 10^-40 bracket, [123239559058361081983852878412972198415914793719936897926499081872887/281456584757098479509944550515200000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000, 619974246770223089945118392610008565852855028054286523715368951086693/1407282923785492397549722752576000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000], lies inside. The lower end is positive, so no subsequential limit of either family has the Haar product as its R-marginal; the tier does not identify the limit and is not an interaction-shift, Euclidean-node or dynamical statement; the -tau interval replays the same |tau| formula. (3) 2D alone is not a boundary comparison: each limit lies within D of P_R, so limits at +tau and -tau lie within 2D of each other although ||rho_R(+tau)-rho_R(-tau)||_1 >= sqrt(10)|tau|/36-2K_2' tau^2 >= 315493271189404369878663368737136921794795815043212654249128159/360264428489086053772729024659456000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (~8.75726955649e-10); the comparison content is the matching first-order term with the 2K_2' tau^2 difference at the same coupling. (4) The falsifying scenario is not excluded: two density matrices on H_R, psi_pm=Omega_R+(tau/144)sum_f e_f +- nu(e_yz0-e_yz1+e_yz2-e_yz3) with e_f=2W_f Omega_R and nu=K_2' tau^2(1-10^-6)/4, satisfy every admitted one-state constraint (the AY1 ball K_2' tau^2, the AV1 ball D, the AW1 Wilson band K_2^+ tau^2, the reset energy 98|tau|, gauge invariance) and differ by at least (1-2*10^-6)2K_2' tau^2=483384822465884568383225451154749885198587818932560615906528253439/180132214244543026886364512329728000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (~2.68350014178e-12); the present one-state bounds therefore cannot exclude two subsequential limits differing this much on R; the witness is not a constructed limit (transfers_to_aq false). (5) Six obligations, all unproved, each with its missing premise and candidate route: uniqueness of the limit, not proved (HTW-type local stability with evaluated constants, the Yarotsky constants c_1(S), c_2(S), or a Dobrushin-type condition; none evaluated); whole-sequence convergence, not proved (a Cauchy estimate in N, or within-family identification of all subsequential limits plus AQ1 compactness); translation invariance under coarse translations, not proved (covariance of the construction plus identification of the limits over every exhausting sequence); a rate in N, not proved (a quantitative Cauchy estimate); boundary independence of dynamics on compact time windows, not proved (a Duhamel and Lieb-Robinson comparison over the 28N(5N+1) boundary faces at distance N-1 with the AQ1 Nachtergaele-Sims constants F(r)=(1+r)^-4, C<=224, ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau| and ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau|; unwritten); dynamics of the padded family itself, not proved (Nachtergaele-Sims with the owner-set interaction and AQ1 sections 4-5; unwritten). (6) K_2' versus K_2^+: K_2' bounds the trace norm sup over ||A||<=1 in B(H_R) of |Tr(r_R A)|, while K_2^+=81108864767825329926713064490531229475390625/24176936535511801466930759024724079017984 (~3354.80322946) bounds the single observable W and is uniform in N; every valid trace-norm constant is also a valid W constant, and every trace-norm constant assembled from the AW1 items is at least 2rho/tau^2~6708.2 because the AM2 remainder dominates both, so face restriction cannot make K_2' smaller than K_2^+; K_2'/K_2^+~3.99950; the AY1 wording 'not the whole-box K_2^+' means 'built from R-local face pins', not a smaller constant; the labelled variants (sqrt-2 sectors ~9487.945, 288-majorant ~10978.18, both ~7763.06, admitted-eps ~13417.81) are previews only. Every constant is uniform in N at fixed spacing and fixed tau and is not uniform in the lattice spacing a. Not admitted: identification of the limits (uniqueness), whole-sequence convergence, a rate in N, translation invariance, boundary independence of the dynamics, dynamics of the padded family, any dynamical, interaction-shift, continuum or weak-coupling statement, and scientific priority.
limitations: Only the zero-selected patterned family (selected triple (0,0,0), Haar reference), the cover R={0,e_z}, fixed spacing and |tau|<=10^-8, with the two named families on centered cubes Lambda_N, N>=2; nothing transfers to literal vertex boxes, periodic or orthant boxes, nonzero selected triples, the uniform route-B model, weak coupling or the continuum; every constant is uniform in N at fixed spacing, never in a

Uniform local closeness on the fixed region R at the same coupling plus a static two-sided distance tier; not uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence, translation invariance, a rate in N, boundary independence of the dynamics or dynamics of the padded family (all six obligations unproved); two limits may differ by up to 2K_2' tau^2 on R and without bound elsewhere

The tier first_order_distance_from_product is static: not an interaction shift, Euclidean node or dynamical statement; its positive lower end excludes the Haar product on R but does not identify any limit; it is the AY1 labelled observation certified under the AY2 contract, not a new mathematical result

The falsifying witness is a pair of density matrices on H_R that satisfies every admitted one-state constraint; it shows what the bounds leave open and is not a constructed limit (transfers_to_aq false)

The candidate routes are named, not executed: HTW/Yarotsky constants c_1, c_2, c_HTW(1,1) are unevaluated (AM2 gate); a Dobrushin-type condition is not formulated for this model; the Lieb-Robinson constants for the dynamics rows are AQ1's Nachtergaele-Sims constants (F(r)=(1+r)^-4, C<=224, ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau|) and the named ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau|, not AM2 constants; the contract's 'with the AM2 constants' is wording only

Inherited without re-proof: AM2 majorant, fixed point, exclusion and cutoff passage; AV1 split and cutoff-vector removal (F22); AY1 F13/F14 and the passage to every limit through closed trace-norm balls; AQ1 compactness and extraction; the I1 dictionary; SU(2) Haar orthogonality and the spectral theorem are standard
Constants are upper bounds except the certified lower end; K_2' is 99.99% the generic AM2 majorant 4rho

The mandatory sentence in the producer report is the Jung loop-2 form (AY1 forward section 6); the AY1-contract template (verbatim in the AY1 gate) is carried here in the supported statement with the constants filled; the AY2 preregistration has no template field

Single producer, correlated model agents: the contract, selection note, AY1 gate and the skeptic's AY1 review state the headline values; independence is limited to route and code; isolation is shown by disclosure, file-name-only exposure and content, not by commit order (the skeptic pre-comparison commit f640111 follows the producer commit ce6bca8; the skeptic's exact values were final at 03:34:06Z, before the producer's check.py and report were last written)

model: Same families, cover R={0,e_z}, clock and constants as AY1 (zero-selected patterned family at both signs |tau|<=10^-8; F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes, F2 = I1 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N, N>=2); statement loop with one forward producer and the skeptic's independent derivation and replays
decision: Admit the AY2 statement: (1) the mandatory sentence with the AY1 gate constants (2D about 2.7225e-8 for any two subsequential limits of F1, F2 at the same tau; the common first-order density rho^(1)_R; 2K_2' tau^2 about 2.68e-12 after subtracting it); (2) the six-row obligations table, every row unproved with its missing premise and candidate route: uniqueness (HTW-type local stability or a Dobrushin-type condition at the cap; the Yarotsky constants of I1 are existential, not evaluated), whole-sequence convergence (a Cauchy estimate in N), translation invariance (covariance plus uniqueness; coarse translations only), a rate in N, boundary independence of dynamics on compact time windows (a Lieb-Robinson/Duhamel comparison over the 28N(5N+1) extra F2 boundary faces with the AQ1 Nachtergaele-Sims constants F(r)=(1+r)^-4, C<=224, ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau|, ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau|, not the AM2 constants as the contract wrote), and dynamics of the padded family itself; (3) the falsifying scenario: an exact pair of gauge-invariant densities on H_R satisfying every admitted one-state constraint and differing by at least (1-2x10^-6) 2K_2' tau^2, which the present bounds cannot exclude; the +tau and -tau limits differ on R by at least 2L about 8.757e-10 while each lies within D (not 2D) of P_R, so the comparison content is the matching first-order term; (4) the two-sided tier first_order_distance_from_product, static_not_dynamic: for every subsequential limit of either family, L <= ||rho_R-P_R||_1 <= U at |tau|=10^-8 with the producer's exact rationals L = 315493271189404369878663368737136921794795815043212654249128159/720528856978172107545458049318912000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (about 4.3786e-10) and U = 317426814346354222051900617016352553019063789598114401371582241/720528856978172107545458049318912000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (about 4.4055e-10), sqrt(10) bracketed to 10^-30 with directed rounding (the skeptic's 10^-40 bracket is the tighter independent enclosure, inside the producer's), relative width about 6.11e-3 meeting the preregistered 1/100 with margin about 1.64; the positive lower end shows that no chosen subsequential limit of either family has the Haar product as its R-marginal, without identifying the limit; (5) the corrected K_2' versus K_2^+ reading (trace norm over B(H_R) versus the single observable W; the AM2 remainder dominates; K_2^+ is volume-uniform and W-specific, not 'whole-box'). The rho^(1)_R pieces are rank two each (eigenvalues +-|tau|/144), the sum has eigenvalues +-sqrt(10)tau/144 and trace norm sqrt(10)|tau|/72 (producer correction R1 and skeptic S1). Recorded non-blocking: the producer filled the Jung loop-2 sentence form and the skeptic's supported statement carries the AY1-contract template with constants (the AY2 preregistration has no template field); the dynamics-row route text repeats 'AM2 constants' while its constants column names AQ1; check.py records but does not pin the AY1 gate hash (freeze verification and the skeptic validator catch edits); the contract defects D1-D6 (selected_after left as the placeholder '<preceding gate>' at freeze time; 'uniqueness of the AQ state' in the exclusions; rate_in_N_claimed missing from gate_fields_required; 'within 2D' should read 'within D'; the K_2^+ wording; 'certified' in selection_reason before certification); commit order (producer ce6bca8 before the skeptic pre-comparison f640111; the skeptic's values were final before the producer's last writes, isolation rests on disclosure and content). No uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence, translation invariance, rate in N, boundary independence of dynamics, interaction-shift, dynamical, continuum or priority statement is admitted. Sub-round 4 complete; panel update 4 next.
